speaker: Unknown
en: Let's talk a little bit about IA, if you like.
zh: 让我们稍微谈谈 IA，如果你愿意。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know that Mo is your IA assistant.
zh: 我知道 Mo 是你的 IA 助手。

speaker: Unknown
en: What I would like to do first is to understand a little bit in the health sector, of course, IA is a major issue because it is an essential trust issue.
zh: 我想首先做的是稍微理解一下在卫生部门，当然，IA 是一个主要问题，因为这是一个基本的信任问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can't say anything.
zh: 你不能乱说。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I would like to first understand a little bit how you decided to use IA within Alan.
zh: 我想首先稍微理解一下你是如何决定在 Alan 内部使用 IA 的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I imagine that
zh: 我想象

speaker: Unknown
en: You had to set a framework for what you wanted to do, what you wanted to experiment with, what you wanted to launch your IA on, whether it was for internal use or for external use.
zh: 你必须为你想要做的事情，你想要实验的事情，你想要在上面启动 IA 的事情制定一个框架，无论是为了内部使用还是为了外部使用。

speaker: Unknown
en: How did you set up your roadmap, the framework, to be able to make Domo, this assistant, and make IA something that can be used by all Alanners?
zh: 你是如何制定你的路线图、框架的，以便能够制作 Domo，这个助手，并使 IA 成为所有 Alanners 可以使用的东西？

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a formal training in IA around 2010-2011.
zh: 我在 2010-2011 年左右接受过 IA 的正式培训。

speaker: Unknown
en: which was well before everything that was generative IA.
zh: 那是在生成式 IA 的一切之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: But in fact, it always made me want to put IA in a certain form in Alan.
zh: 但实际上，它一直让我想在某种程度上将 IA 放入 Alan。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we had this vision from the beginning that artificial intelligence would be extremely important.
zh: 所以我们从一开始就有这种愿景，即人工智能将非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: After that, we couldn't expect what happened next.
zh: 在那之后，我们无法预料接下来发生的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we still laid the foundations of how we could work effectively with IA.
zh: 但我们仍然奠定了我们如何能够与 IA 有效合作的基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: quite a lot changed around the end of 2021, early 2022, where we felt that GPT-3-type models had become extremely powerful.
zh: 在 2021 年底、2022 年初左右发生了相当大的变化，那时我们觉得 GPT-3 类型的模型已经变得非常强大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at that moment, we said to ourselves, we're going to start transforming the company with IA.
zh: 在那一刻，我们对自己说，我们要开始用 IA 转变公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we started doing that with three big steps.
zh: 所以我们开始通过三个大步骤来做到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the one hand, team productivity.
zh: 一方面，团队生产力。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the other hand, the improvement of processes to make them cheaper and of better quality.
zh: 另一方面，改进流程以使它们更便宜且质量更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And finally, the creation of new products that could never have existed before IA.
zh: 最后，创造在 IA 之前永远不可能存在的新产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, in particular, our medical agent Mo, we started to build it in 2023-2024.
zh: 所以，特别是我们的医疗智能体 Mo，我们开始在 2023-2024 年构建它。

speaker: Unknown
en: under the inspiration of a person who was our first engineer, Antoine Liset, who took the subject and said, I want to create this medical agent because it's the first time we can create something that really makes sense in health with IA.
zh: 在一位曾是我们第一位工程师 Antoine Liset 的人的启发下，他接手了这个话题并说，我想创建这个医疗智能体，因为这是第一次我们可以用 IA 创造一些在健康领域真正有意义的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: from first principles.
zh: 从第一性原理出发。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we managed, with a collaboration between engineers and doctors, to build a medical agent with whom we have trust.
zh: 通过工程师和医生之间的合作，我们设法构建了一个我们信任的医疗智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: We published a scientific paper with the results of our IA.
zh: 我们发表了一篇科学论文，其中包含我们 IA 的结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: 80% of people prefer to use our IA than to wait half an hour to talk to a doctor.
zh: 80% 的人更喜欢使用我们的 IA，而不是等半个小时与医生交谈。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then, 95% of the responses given by this IA agent are noted as good or excellent by doctors who review the conversations.
zh: 然后，这个 IA 智能体给出的 95% 的回复被审查对话的医生评为良好或优秀。

speaker: Unknown
en: So at the end of the day, the question is, can we use these tools to give a completely different experience in terms of health?
zh: 所以归根结底，问题是，我们能否利用这些工具在健康方面提供完全不同的体验？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that's what we managed to do with me.
zh: 我认为这就是我们设法用 me 做到的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's great.
zh: 那很棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would like us to go even beyond Alan.
zh: 我希望我们要超越 Alan。

speaker: Unknown
en: I also know that you are co-founder of Mistral.
zh: 我也知道你是 Mistral 的联合创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't want you to talk to us about Mistral necessarily, but rather from your point of view on IA in France.
zh: 我不想让你一定跟我们谈谈 Mistral，而是谈谈你对法国 IA 的看法。

speaker: Unknown
en: on IA in Europe.
zh: 谈谈欧洲的 IA。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why is it an essential subject and what do you see with your eyes in terms of adoption and where do you think people in this room should put emphasis in the coming years?
zh: 为什么这是一个至关重要的主题，并且根据你的观察，在采用方面你看到了什么，以及你认为在这个房间里的人在接下来几年应该把重点放在哪里？

speaker: Unknown
en: what is certain is that it is really a technological revolution today that no one could have missed but it is not only one technological revolution which took place around 2023-2024 rather in the form of chatbots but it is also a new technological revolution with agents
zh: 可以确定的是，今天这确实是一场任何人都不可能错过的技术革命，但它不仅仅是一场发生在 2023-2024 年左右的以聊天机器人为形式的技术革命，它也是一场关于智能体的新技术革命。

speaker: Unknown
en: really the fact that agents can do tasks instead of humans, it completely changes the game again.
zh: 确实，智能体可以代替人类执行任务这一事实，再次完全改变了游戏规则。

speaker: Unknown
en: What we said in mid-2022 is that we were completely indebted to a single American company, which was OpenAI, because we used GPT-3 very strongly at the time.
zh: 我们在 2022 年中说的是，我们当时完全欠着一家美国公司的债，那就是 OpenAI，因为我们当时非常大量地使用 GPT-3。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we said to ourselves, we absolutely need to be a European champion because it will be a form of insurance for us in case there will be geopolitical problems that will cause a brutal decoupling to happen in the following years.
zh: 我们对自己说，我们绝对需要成为欧洲的冠军，因为这对我们将是一种保险，以防未来几年发生地缘政治问题导致出现残酷的脱钩。

speaker: Unknown
en: It turns out that this is what happened more or less this weekend.
zh: 结果表明，这或多或少就是本周末发生的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the fact of having emerged a champion like Mistral has become extremely important.
zh: 因此，涌现出一个像 Mistral 这样的冠军已经变得极其重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the question of how we build this sovereignty, I think it is extremely important that all companies, all...
zh: 关于我们要如何构建这种主权，我认为极其重要的是，所有的公司，所有的……

speaker: Unknown
en: all the organizations that are on the application layer or above adopt the IA, adopt the agents and transform with the agents.
zh: 所有位于应用层或之上的组织都采用 IA，采用智能体并随着智能体进行转型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because it is by transforming with agents that we will create enough demand to have an ecosystem that will be viable and therefore that will allow us to invest in more computers, more infrastructure, more data centers, more electricity.
zh: 因为正是通过随着智能体进行转型，我们将创造足够的需求来拥有一个可行的生态系统，从而将使我们能够投资于更多的计算机、更多的基础设施、更多的数据中心、更多的电力。

speaker: Unknown
en: by being able to build value on this whole chain, behind it, France and Europe will have a place in the future of technology.
zh: 通过能够在整个链条上构建价值，在其背后，法国和欧洲将在技术的未来占有一席之地。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we don't do it at all at the application level or above,
zh: 如果我们在应用层或之上根本不做这件事，

speaker: Unknown
en: we're just going to have actors who are trying to get involved in terms of models, in terms of computing, who are going to go bankrupt and, in the end, who won't be able to make their investments.
zh: 我们将只有一些试图在模型层面、在计算层面参与进来的参与者，他们将破产，而且最终，他们将无法进行他们的投资。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, in the end, we'll have almost abandoned the subject.
zh: 所以，最终，我们几乎会放弃这个主题。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there's really an opportunity for France, for Europe, for the companies here, to adopt, to understand that it has a lot of value.
zh: 所以，对于法国、欧洲、这里的企业来说，确实有一个机会去采用，去理解它具有巨大的价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's a lot of it.
zh: 而且有很多价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a graph that I often show to talk about how valuable this technological revolution on AI is.
zh: 我经常展示一张图表来谈谈这场 AI 技术革命有多大价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a graph of income by full-time employees at Alan.
zh: 那是 Alan 全职员工的收入图表。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the income per employee at full time was in an almost linear increase for several years until 2022, where we made our transformation yesterday.
zh: 所以，全职员工的人均收入在几年内几乎呈线性增长，直到 2022 年，那时我们在昨天进行了转型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Since 2022, this curve is exponential.
zh: 自 2022 年以来，这条曲线是指数级的。

speaker: Unknown
en: In fact, we see it in a very macro way with Alan, but each person is able to create a lot more value with IA agents than they were able to create value with the classic software.
zh: 事实上，我们以非常宏观的方式在 Alan 看到了这一点，但每个人都能用 IA 智能体创造比用经典软件创造价值多得多的价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this subject, in fact, I think it is replicated in almost all companies.
zh: 而这个主题，事实上，我认为它在几乎所有公司都在复制。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the subject is how do we make this transformation?
zh: 所以问题是我们如何实现这种转型？

speaker: Unknown
en: in the right way in these companies to be able to benefit from this explosion.
zh: 在这些公司里以正确的方式，以便能够从这种爆发中受益。

speaker: Unknown
en: And behind this explosion of productivity, we will be able to redistribute it in four ways.
zh: 在这种生产力爆发的背后，我们将能够通过四种方式重新分配它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Either we will be able to cut costs,
zh: 要么我们能够削减成本，

speaker: Unknown
en: but in general it's quite short-term.
zh: 但通常这是相当短期的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Either we will be able to invest that in more quantity, we will be able to treat more things, and so, for example, in Alan's case, it will be in more countries.
zh: 要么我们能够将其投资于更大的数量，我们将能够处理更多的事情，因此，例如，在 Alan 的例子中，那就是在更多的国家。

speaker: Unknown
en: Either we will be able to increase the quality of the rendu, so we will be able to spend a little more time on each case.
zh: 要么我们能够提高 rendu 的质量，所以我们能够在每个案例上花更多的时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in health, it is to have doctors who will be able to spend a little more time looking at their patients in the eyes.
zh: 所以在健康领域，就是让医生能够多花一点时间看着他们的病人的眼睛。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or the fourth way is to give back to the employees.
zh: 或者第四种方式是回馈给员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: In 1930, John Maynard Keynes said that 100 years later, we would work 15 hours a week.
zh: 1930 年，约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯说，100 年后，我们将每周工作 15 小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: So 100 years later, it's 2030.
zh: 所以 100 年后，就是 2030 年。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, we are not going to work 15 hours a week in an almost guaranteed way, but if we wanted to keep the level of life of 1930, we could probably work 15 hours a week.
zh: 今天，我们几乎肯定不会每周工作 15 小时，但如果我们想保持 1930 年的生活水平，我们可能每周只需工作 15 小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the point is that we have a productivity gain that is quite enormous that we will be able to redistribute in these four ways.
zh: 但关键在于，我们有一个相当巨大的生产力收益，我们将能够通过这四种方式重新分配它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And your opinion on the level of maturity of France, perhaps in relation to what you see in other countries?
zh: 关于法国的成熟度水平，也许与你观察到的其他国家相比，你有什么看法？

speaker: Unknown
en: So...
zh: 所以……

speaker: Unknown
en: What I see today is that France has understood the importance of the subject.
zh: 我今天看到的是，法国已经理解了这个主题的重要性。

speaker: Unknown
en: After that, we have a difficulty in France, which is that we were late on the digitalization, on the cloudification of our economy.
zh: 在那之后，我们在法国有一个困难，那就是我们在经济的数字化、云化方面起步晚。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so it takes a little more time to transform.
zh: 所以转型需要多一点时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that, as we have understood, we have today the right mindset to be able to move forward.
zh: 我认为，正如我们所理解的，我们今天拥有正确的心态，能够继续前进。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then, we are still behind in terms of mindset on the United States or China, because they tend to say to themselves, we will go there, we will move forward and we will then understand what is good or what is not good, while we tend a little bit more in France, in Europe, to say to ourselves,
zh: 然后，在心态方面，我们仍然落后于美国或中国，因为他们倾向于对自己说，我们会去那里，我们会前进，然后我们会理解什么是好的或什么是坏的，而我们倾向于在法国、欧洲对自己说，

speaker: Unknown
en: There is this new technology that scares us.
zh: 有这种新技术让我们害怕。

speaker: Unknown
en: We will try to regulate it first, before completely understanding how it is going to work.
zh: 我们将首先尝试监管它，在完全理解它是如何运作之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would like you to address, if you will, managerial practices.
zh: 我希望你能谈谈，如果你愿意的话，管理实践。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because maybe through IA,
zh: 因为也许通过 IA，

speaker: Unknown
en: there are new tools, new possibilities, but there are also managerial practices that you have for the Alaners, which I think allow us to have this fertile ground to adopt these new technologies.
zh: 有新工具、新可能性，但也有你为 Alaners 制定的管理实践，我认为这让我们拥有采用这些新技术的肥沃土壤。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you want to share with us a little bit what your practices are?
zh: 你想跟我们稍微分享一下你的实践是什么吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course.
zh: 当然。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what's interesting is that we've put these practices in place since the first day, since the beginning of 2016.
zh: 有趣的是，我们从第一天起，也就是从 2016 年开始，就建立了这些实践。

speaker: Unknown
en: we had the intuition that what would be important is to have the context that is available to everyone.
zh: 我们直觉地认为，重要的是要有对每个人可用的上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do we get the context that is available to everyone?
zh: 我们如何获得对每个人可用的上下文？

speaker: Unknown
en: We create a radical transparency.
zh: 我们创造了一种彻底的透明度。

speaker: Unknown
en: So with Alan, all the decisions that are made are available to everyone in a transparent way.
zh: 所以在 Alan，所有做出的决定都以透明的方式对每个人可用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And behind it, it's working in writing.
zh: 在其背后，它是书面工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: In fact, when we work in writing, we have this context that is available.
zh: 事实上，当我们书面工作时，我们就有了这种可用的上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, as a person at Alan, I can have access to all the knowledge that has been accumulated by the company since the beginning of the company.
zh: 因此，作为 Alan 的一员，我可以访问公司自成立以来积累的所有知识。

speaker: Unknown
en: So typically, what it will mean is, I will be able to ask the question of why we made such a decision in 2018.
zh: 所以通常这意味着，我将能够问我们在 2018 年做出这样一个决定的原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as much as before the IA, it could take a few hours to do the archaeology to know exactly how we had made this decision, as much as with the IA agents, it now takes a few seconds, and I can say in a very complete way why we make these decisions.
zh: 而且正如在 IA 之前，做考古工作来确切知道我们是如何做出这个决定可能需要几个小时一样，在 IA 智能体的情况下，现在只需要几秒钟，而且我可以用非常完整的方式说明我们为什么做出这些决定。

speaker: Unknown
en: And why is it important?
zh: 为什么这很重要？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's because behind it, it solves a problem called the Shasterton barrier problem.
zh: 是因为在它背后，它解决了一个叫做 Shasterton 障碍问题的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Basically, we end up with a lot of companies who say, we do this like that because we've always done it like that.
zh: 基本上，我们会看到很多公司说，我们这样做是因为我们一直都是这样做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in a company like Alan, with transparency and everything written down, in fact, we are able to say, we do it like this for this specific reason.
zh: 而在像 Alan 这样的公司，具有透明度和所有书面的东西，事实上，我们能够说，我们这样做是因为这个特定的原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: So behind it, it means that we are able to say, this specific reason is caduc.
zh: 所以在其背后，这意味着我们能够说，这个特定的原因是 caduc。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't want to follow this process anymore because, in fact, this reason is caduc.
zh: 我们不想再遵循这个流程，因为事实上，这个原因是 caduc。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so it allows companies to be much more fluid in terms of management.
zh: 因此它使公司在管理方面更加流畅。

speaker: Unknown
en: Behind, for me, we also have a transformation in terms of management in relation to agents, because instead of being with people who do directly, we make agents do it.
zh: 在背后，对我来说，我们也有关于智能体的管理变革，因为我们不再是与直接做事的人在一起，而是让智能体去做。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we deployed agents on all our operations.
zh: 所以我们在所有业务上部署了智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the people who work in Alan's operations today are much more to work with
zh: 因此，今天在 Alan 业务部门工作的人更多的是去工作

speaker: Unknown
en: to tune their agents, to make sure that the agent is going to do the right thing.
zh: 以调整他们的智能体，以确保智能体会做正确的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they are going to make things happen rather than doing it themselves.
zh: 所以他们将让事情发生，而不是自己做。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that requires a pretty deep change of mindset.
zh: 所以这需要相当深层的思维转变。

speaker: Unknown
en: That means that we are going to have companies that are going to be much less vertical.
zh: 这意味着我们将有垂直度低得多的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: That means that we are going to have companies where knowledge is going to spread in a much more fluid way.
zh: 这意味着我们将有知识将以更流畅方式传播的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, in a way, it's the rehabilitation of a French thinker, a great French engineer named Henri Fayol, who thought of the administration as the delegation with a lot of power for the people who do it.
zh: 所以，在某种程度上，这是一位法国思想家的平反，一位名叫 Henri Fayol 的伟大的法国工程师，他认为行政管理就是给予执行者很大权力的授权。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so what we're going to see with IAIN is that we're going to have people who will have a lot more autonomy, and that involves a lot of things in terms of education and how we should train our young people.
zh: 所以我们将通过 IAIN 看到的是，我们将拥有更多自主权的人，这涉及到教育和我们应该如何培训年轻人等很多事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is very clear is that from what you describe, I find a lot of practices that we have at Stripe, the culture of writing, the culture of absolute transparency, AI First and somehow how a problem is translated by an agent that we train.
zh: 很清楚的是，从你的描述中，我发现很多我们在 Stripe 的实践，写作文化，绝对透明的文化，AI First 以及某种方式下问题如何被我们训练的智能体翻译。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so it's very inspiring to see that it is also the recipe for success to be an agent in our companies.
zh: 所以看到这成为我们公司中智能体的成功秘诀是非常令人鼓舞的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, Alan, it's a success story in French, which is exceptional.
zh: 现在，Alan 是一个在法国的成功故事，这是非常例外的。

speaker: Unknown
en: 10 years of success.
zh: 10 年的成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: We wish you two very, very, very, very long years of success.
zh: 我们祝愿你们拥有非常非常非常长久的成功岁月。

speaker: Unknown
en: What I would like you to share with us is if you tried to write a memo for entrepreneurs, for the next generation, and you had maybe some recommendations in a few lines, what would you like to write?
zh: 我想请你与我们分享的是，如果你试着为企业家、为下一代写一份备忘录，也许用几行字给出一些推荐，你会想写什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: For me, the next generation should be ambitious.
zh: 对我来说，下一代应该是有野心的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think we have been in Europe for too long, a little too complacent.
zh: 我认为我们在欧洲待了太长时间，有点太自满了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this complacency has led some to decline.
zh: 这种自满导致了一些人的衰退。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that the next generation of entrepreneurs must have this sense of urgency.
zh: 我认为下一代企业家必须拥有这种紧迫感。

speaker: Unknown
en: The fact that the French and European civilisation can die, as Paul Valéry said.
zh: 正如 Paul Valéry 所说，法国和欧洲文明可能会消亡这一事实。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the point is, how can we...
zh: 但问题是，我们如何……

speaker: Unknown
en: we manage to give a civilization some strength.
zh: 我们设法给一个文明某种力量。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think it's through entrepreneurship.
zh: 我认为这要通过创业精神。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's through questioning established standards.
zh: 这通过质疑既定的标准。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's through trying to do things that are ambitious, big, and that, in the end, can make the country shine all over the world.
zh: 这通过尝试做有野心的大事，最终，这可以让国家在全世界闪耀。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think we had a little forgotten that in France, in Europe.
zh: 我认为我们在法国、在欧洲有一点忘记了这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now we have a new technology with IA that allows us to take our hand on our destiny a little bit.
zh: 现在我们有了 IA 这项新技术，让我们能稍微掌握我们的命运。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so if we have this urgency and this ambition, we will achieve something of great effort.
zh: 所以如果我们有这种紧迫感和这种野心，我们将实现某种伟大的努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Charles, really a very, very, very big thank you.
zh: Charles，真的非常非常非常感谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am very, very inspired when I listen to you.
zh: 听你说话时，我感到非常非常受启发。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are very proud at Stripe to have been able to accompany Alan since its inception.
zh: 在 Stripe，我们感到非常自豪能够自 Alan 成立以来陪伴它。

speaker: Unknown
en: We will be very proud to be able to continue to accompany you for years to come.
zh: 我们将非常自豪能够继续在未来几年里陪伴您。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for your sharing today.
zh: 感谢您今天的分享。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I will take this opportunity to close.
zh: 我将借此机会结束。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you, Laurent.
zh: 谢谢，Laurent。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you very much.
zh: 非常感谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, after this intervention from Charles, I would like to wish you the end of Stripe Tour Paris.
zh: 那么，在 Charles 的这段发言之后，我想祝愿你们 Stripe Tour 圆满结束。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was, at least I hope for all of you, a moment of sharing, a moment of exchange.
zh: 这至少我希望能对你们所有人来说，是一个分享的时刻，一个交流的时刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe also a moment where you were able to discover new ideas.
zh: 也许也是你们能够发现新想法的时刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are very happy to have been able to share all these announcements with you.
zh: 我们非常高兴能够与你们分享所有这些公告。

speaker: Unknown
en: We know that sometimes it takes a lot of things to try to absorb in one day.
zh: 我们知道有时一天内要尝试吸收很多东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And of course, you have access to our roadmap, but you have access to all our teams to continue these beautiful conversations, these beautiful meetings.
zh: 当然，你们可以访问我们的路线图，但你们可以访问我们所有的团队以继续这些美好的对话，这些美好的会议。

speaker: Unknown
en: Stripe has built the infrastructure to help you, the entrepreneurs, the builders, the business leaders, to try to develop your businesses wherever they are, and we try to feed the development of our products thanks to your ideas, to your feedbacks, and with a lot of humility, continue to share these feedbacks with us.
zh: Stripe 构建了基础设施来帮助你们，帮助企业家、构建者、商业领袖，尝试在任何地方发展你们的企业，而我们尝试根据你们的想法、你们的反馈来推动我们产品的发展，并带着很多谦卑，继续与我们分享这些反馈。

speaker: Unknown
en: because they are important to us and allow us to continue to improve.
zh: 因为它们对我们很重要，并允许我们继续改进。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am also very happy to have been able to welcome all our partners and I hope that you have had the opportunity to meet them.
zh: 我也非常高兴能够欢迎我们所有的合作伙伴，我希望你们有机会见到了他们。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are important for the Stripe ecosystem because they allow us to build with them the solutions that we are able to offer you.
zh: 他们对 Stripe 生态系统很重要，因为他们让我们能够与他们一起构建我们能够向你们提供的解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: In any case, this closing word, I wish you all the best.
zh: 无论如何，作为这番结束寄语，我祝愿你们一切顺利。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you all.
zh: 谢谢大家。

speaker: Unknown
en: Tonight, France will begin this beautiful adventure with Kylian, who will be on the field.
zh: 今晚，法国将与 Kylian 一起开始这项美丽的冒险，他将出现在球场上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wish you a good end to the day.
zh: 祝你们度过美好的一天。

speaker: Unknown
en: In any case, thank you all and go Blue!
zh: 无论如何，谢谢大家，加油 Blue！
